output.review_comment: Request changes: PR lacks any description and contains three significant changes without justification. The 20kg maximum weight limit appears suspiciously specific and looks potentially reverse-engineered from test data. The <= to < change in tier logic is a core business logic change needing explanation. Agent should revise with: (1) PR description explaining each change, (2) justification that changes match specification not just tests, (3) clarification of weight tier boundary semantics. Rounding change is defensible but all modifications need context.
